parameters.name: ImageId
parameters.description: The image ID.

parameters.name: InnerIpAddresses
parameters.description:
The list of private IP addresses of instances in the classic network. This parameter takes effect when InstanceNetworkType is set to classic. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 IP addresses. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,).

> - The classic network feature has been discontinued. For more information, see [Discontinuation notice](~~2833134~~).

parameters.name: InstanceChargeType
parameters.description:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

- PostPaid: pay-as-you-go.
- PrePaid: subscription.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the instances. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 instance IDs. Separate the IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the instance. Fuzzy search with the wildcard * is supported.

parameters.name: InstanceNetworkType
parameters.description: The network type of the instance. Valid values:

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description: The instance type.

parameters.name: InstanceTypeFamily
parameters.description: The instance family.

parameters.name: InternetChargeType
parameters.description:
The billing method for public bandwidth. Valid values:

- PayByBandwidth: pay-by-bandwidth.
- PayByTraffic: pay-by-traffic.

> In **pay-by-traffic** mode, the peak inbound and outbound bandwidths are both bandwidth upper limits and are not guaranteed. When resource contention occurs, the peak bandwidth may be throttled. If your business requires guaranteed bandwidth, use the **pay-by-bandwidth** mode.

parameters.name: IoOptimized
parameters.description: Specifies whether the instance is I/O optimized. Valid values:

parameters.name: Ipv6Address
parameters.description: The IPv6 addresses assigned to the Elastic Network Interface (ENI).

parameters.name: KeyPairName
parameters.description: The name of the SSH key pair used by the instance.

parameters.name: LockReason
parameters.description:
The reason why the resource is locked. Valid values:

- financial: The resource is locked due to overdue payment.

- security: The resource is locked for security reasons.

- Recycling: The spot instance is locked and pending release.

- dedicatedhostfinancial: The ECS instance is locked because the dedicated host has an overdue payment.

- refunded: The resource is locked due to a refund.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100.

Default value:

- If this parameter is not set or is set to a value less than 10, the default value is 10.
- If this parameter is set to a value greater than 100, the default value is 100.

parameters.name: NeedSaleCycle
parameters.description: > This parameter is in invitational preview and is not publicly available.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The query token. Set the value to the `NextToken` value returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: > This parameter is about to be deprecated. Use NextToken and MaxResults to complete paging query operations.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: > This parameter is about to be deprecated. Use NextToken and MaxResults to complete paging query operations.

parameters.name: PrivateIpAddresses
parameters.description: The private IP addresses of instances in a VPC network type. This parameter takes effect when InstanceNetworkType is set to vpc. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 IP addresses. Separate the IP addresses with commas (,).

parameters.name: PublicIpAddresses
parameters.description: The public IP addresses of the instances. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 IP addresses. Separate the IP addresses with commas (,).

parameters.name: RdmaIpAddresses
parameters.description: The RDMA IP addresses of the HPC instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the enterprise resource group to which the instance belongs. When you use this parameter to filter resources, the number of resources cannot exceed 1,000.

>Filtering by the default resource group is not supported.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the security group to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The instance status. Valid values:

- Pending: being created.
- Running: running.
- Starting: being started.
- Stopping: being stopped.
- Stopped: stopped.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag list.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the vSwitch.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC).

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID.
